subject: Social Media
title: The Switching Tax
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Switching Tax.

hook.text: You check your phone 'for one second.' Twenty minutes vanish. The one-second check was never one second.

buildup.text: Gloria Mark's research shows each interruption costs 23 minutes of recovery. Your brain can't just resume.

discovery.text: Context switching burns glucose. Your prefrontal cortex reloads the previous task like rebooting a computer.

twist.text: People switch tasks every 3 minutes on average. That's 150 context switches per 8-hour day. Recovery is constant.

climax.text: Cal Newport calls this 'attention residue.' Part of your mind stays on the last task. You're never fully here.

punchline.text: Multitasking isn't doing two things. It's doing neither well.

quiz.question: How long does it take to refocus after an interruption?
